0.0: This place was originally just a haven for the wise (and the cute, like me), but then it became a tourist hotspot because it's so beautiful. But recently, the influence of the demon #rRavana#k has started leeching out from the forest...
0.1: The beautiful, peaceful forest has transformed into a dangerous place, scaring all the tourists away and scaring ME. Some of the monks went to fight Ravana, but not a single one has returned... And now, I'm the only one left! How can they be so selfish?
0.2: Not ten days ago, my mentor #b#p9000072##k was still here with me, but then he, too ventured into the forest... Please, you have to help! Go to the #bForest of Training#k and look for #b#p9000072##k! I'd go myself but the monkeys like to pick on me because I'm cuter than they are.

yes.0: Head #bright#k to leave the temple, and you'll find a path that connects to the #bForest of Training#k.\nEliminate #b#e100#n #e#o8144000# monsters#n#k and find #r#eSomchai#n#k, who's somewhere in the forest.
